prompt: The camera stays square to the stalls and creeps very slowly closer through the drizzle, building tension. The horses stand tight: bridles jingle, a jockey's gloved hand tightens on the reins, breath steams from the grey's nostrils. At about three seconds the three front gates fly open together with a loud spring-loaded crash and swing toward the lens. The two horses on the left and centre burst forward at once, flinging up wet grass; the chestnut on the right simply watches them go. Sound: rain patter, creak of steel, the crash of the gates, a rush of hooves, no talking. Real-looking footage of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day. Thanks.
